content: Section 3.2 of the American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines highlights the critical importance of monitoring individuals who are at risk of developing type 1 diabetes. This is particularly emphasized for younger children under the age of 3. In this population, the presence of multiple autoantibodies and the development of autoantibodies against islet antigen 2 (IA-2) are strongly associated with a more rapid progression to clinical type 1 diabetes. Additionally, guidance has been introduced regarding the use of teplizumab, a medication that has been approved to delay the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This drug is indicated for use in adults and pediatric patients aged 8 years and older who are diagnosed with stage 2 type 1 diabetes.
